title: FERPA — directory info, opt-out unknown

decision.llm_response:
Escalation: per-student opt-out status required (34 CFR § 99.37).
Confirm with the registrar that the student has NOT opted out of directory-information designation before disclosing. If opted-out, refuse and route through § 99.30 consent.

advisor_reply: Hi there! To release our basketball team roster, I first need to confirm our directory information opt-out status. Students have the right to restrict sharing of their athletic participation details. Please contact our Registrar's Office to verify current directory information permissions. They can confirm whether team roster details can be shared publicly or with inquirers.
